study: Capsule Review | frozen Galar-27 pathology-ranking transfer on an additional source-verified fitting examination
scientific_role: Exploratory examination-separated training-pool transfer, not a blinded or independent clinical evaluation
disclosure: Examination 27 was chosen because the prior corrected-label fitting-pool audit showed 762 blood-positive annotated rows in four contiguous annotation runs. Its labels have been inspected for acquisition planning, so subsequent inference is not prospectively blinded.

source.dataset: Galar v2; Le Floch et al.; CC BY 4.0

acquisition.method: Fetch each exact verified HTTP 206 7z source block with official metadata, extract and verify its matching requested image members, then delete the compressed block before retrieving the next; never stage the full 31.99-GB source.
acquisition.checks: Verify official 7z index-part SHA256 and CRC, block offsets and lengths, full 14,796 PNG-member inventory, exact original frame indices/labels/roles, PNG decoding, per-frame original SHA256, and final private ZIP CRC. Abort before large transfers on any preflight mismatch.
acquisition.storage: Only original image bytes, private source-frame identities, labels and per-frame scores in Capsule Review Library; no raw medical data in Git.

fixed_selection.primary_reference_scope: 512 frozen label-blind source-chronological positions only, with 26 blood=1 annotation labels; never use intentionally enriched-only frames to estimate natural prevalence.

fixed_comparison.preprocessing: Unchanged capsule_review.baseline.image_tensor, aspect-preserving 96×96 RGB black-pad with orientation correction; float32
fixed_comparison.scores: Positive blood class softmax ranking; scores are not calibrated clinical probabilities
fixed_comparison.per_budget_count: floor(512×budget/100) within examination; descending score then increasing reference position for CNN/redness
primary_metrics: ROC-AUC and average precision on label-blind 512-frame sample
Blood-positive sampled-image hits for each review budget
fixed_comparison.secondary_metrics: Full 1,005-image union, deliberately enriched: descriptive only, explicitly separate from primary
fixed_comparison.decision: Report all methods and all budgets without tuning, threshold adjustment, cherry-picking or automatic model promotion. Maintain negative transfer evidence from exams 23 and 25.
fixed_comparison.uncertainty: Only 26 blood-positive reference images; one examination; no verified patient identity or independent clinical lesion ground truth.

stop_conditions: Abort on model hash mismatch, source-archive/member hash or index mismatch, altered 1,005-image request, missing or duplicate source image, incorrect 512 reference positions/26 reference positives, incorrect data roles, or incomplete artefact. Never treat unknown labels as negative.
